{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Filter out rows where biomarker_baseline is -999.0 (sentinel value)
df_clean = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0]

# Verify the number of remaining rows
n_remaining = len(df_clean)

# Check if baseline and final measurements are now available for all remaining rows
baseline_valid = df_clean['biomarker_baseline'].isnull().sum() == 0
final_valid = df_clean['biomarker_final'].isnull().sum() == 0

# Compute the change in biomarker levels (final - baseline)
df_clean['change'] = df_clean['biomarker_final'] - df_clean['biomarker_baseline']

# Compute the mean change across all patients
mean_change = df_clean['change'].mean()

# Output results
n_remaining, baseline_valid, final_valid, mean_change"}
